authority: D-20260916-GOAL05 (goal Round 2 of 10: JGCL-style single-geometry InfoNCE; Track I P1)
evidence_scope: train/valid dev only; NO reserved (J03WQQ) or external (SoccerTrack) reads

model.class: AMRModelV6 reused VERBATIM (scripts/amr_model_v6.py hash must match v6 lock — proves zero arch change)
model.encoder: shared GraphEncoder (single-geometry loss is the tug-of-war removal test)

loss.rule: ONE InfoNCE over mode embeddings: anchors=64 queries, candidates=q+p+v (192), positives per anchor={natural positive, Slepian view}, in-batch negatives, tau=0.1

schedule.optimizer: Adam lr=1e-3 wd=0 (single group; no predictor anymore)

guards.collapse: mean mode-embedding std < 1e-4 for 3 consecutive post-warmup epochs -> COLLAPSED

evaluation_plan.frozen: valid context/intrinsic(pair ranking on InfoNCE embeddings)/translation + t5r5_support_reallocation_v1 eps=0.25 + singular top-10 + mu means
evaluation_plan.R2_decision: margins/pair SHARPER than triplet系 with H1 held -> big-number hope, remaining rounds to N4+paper; H1 fail (either channel) -> single-geometry insufficient at this scale -> R3 freeze-then-route; collapse -> negatives need scale (Track G lesson) -> R3 momentum-teacher+InfoNCE hybrid

calibration.no_init_balancing: single mechanism loss needs no grad-norm parity (that problem belonged to multi-loss)
calibration.risk_noted: small-batch InfoNCE (191 in-batch negs) may underperform per Track G SimCLR lesson; failure is informative, pre-registered above
